subject: LTE phone field as Remote ID
statement: LteUserPhoneNumberSet is a set-only no-readback 0x03/0xDA LTE HYBRID business path and ordinary standards-based Broadcast RID has no operator telephone message element.
boundary: The source of a telephone displayed by proprietary detection software remains unknown and may be a China account or registry association.

subject: Compliance serial number identity
statement: ComplianceSerialNumber is get-listen-only and derives a 20-character compliance form from a 14-character aircraft serial while no setter was found.
boundary: The transform is consistent with a compliance identity candidate but static code does not prove WA150 RF Basic ID uses it; full serial values are excluded.

subject: Separate synthetic OpenDroneID source
statement: A reviewed external Linux or embedded OpenDroneID source could expose synthetic standards-message fields for detector compatibility tests without modifying WA150 firmware or real account identity.
boundary: No RF backend is implemented or admitted; hardware identity readback stop proof restart behavior independent reception and regulatory test controls remain required.

subject: China UOM identifier reply layout
statement: Current OIDIdentifier Set and Get reply consumers take the result from byte 1 while a successful Get constructs the eight-byte value from bytes 2 through 9.
boundary: Byte 0 semantics and complete result mapping are unknown; a defensive parser requires at least 2 bytes for Set and 10 for Get and no live Mini 5 Pro ACK was captured.

subject: China UOM real-name status getter
statement: UOMRealNameStatusGet uses 0x11/0xD1 receiver type/index 2/0 request 01 00 timeout 500 milliseconds and three retries then maps a four-byte-or-longer response to not-authorized valid cancelled verified-cancelled unsupported or unknown status.
boundary: External helper result mappings are not present in the analyzed library and the status is China UOM authentication state rather than a Broadcast RID switch.

subject: China UOM runtime admission and server-mediated sync
statement: CommonFcAbs adds UOMV1 only when function discovery admits 0x6C; its Sync path gathers device parameters uses a China-only DeviceCenter account-server verification and applies the response through the 0x11/0xD1 aircraft lane while the official cancellation action likewise waits for server success before a D1 synchronization.
boundary: UOMV1 has no generic local key setter and the managed cancellation path is not an offline restore or Broadcast RID switch; live Mini 5 Pro 0x6C admission authenticated result final applied readback persistence and RF effects remain unknown.

subject: RidCaptureV1 characteristic inventory
statement: Exact RidCaptureV1 creates nine characteristics: four listen-only Cloud EU France and Japan capability flags; the Japan RIDRegistedInfo action and RIDImportResult getter; OperatorRegistrationNumber and EIDSwitch GET-SET characteristics; and SET-only UploadMobileDevicePosition with 1000-millisecond characteristic metadata.
boundary: This is a mixed-access dynamically admitted bundle rather than nine writable RID settings; it is not a global broadcast switch and does not prove live Mini 5 Pro key existence.

subject: RID capability-bundle runtime admission
statement: CommonFcAbs creates and binds RidCaptureV1 for function-discovery ID 0x37 with the required admission flag; ID 0x38 instead creates UnofficialBatteryAuthenticationV1 and the SDK contains the general 0x00/0xB8 function-discovery transport.
boundary: Function IDs command IDs and FlySafe PackType values are separate namespaces; static mapping does not prove the live Mini 5 Pro reports 0x37 and the handler may use cached discovery state.

subject: Current AirSense tuple exclusions
statement: Current exact native and FlyModel paths identify 0x11/0x0C as a read-write AirSense ADS-B receive switch 0x11/0x39 as a set-only AirSense synthetic-target test action and 0x11/0x37 as an inherited ADSB agent-switch surface with no current RID DIPS or EID caller.
boundary: These tuples are excluded from the RID configuration catalog; this does not prove WA150 firmware rejects raw requests or close the full RF semantics and live support of 0x11/0x37.

subject: Independent RIDCtrlEnable characteristic
statement: The current same-family SDK exposes Boolean RIDCtrlEnable separately from France EIDSwitch; the characteristic supports Get Set and Listen and the application performs a fresh GET after connection to decide whether the switch is visible.
boundary: Dynamic visibility proves a product-dependent capability probe rather than universal Mini 5 Pro support; no live Mini 5 Pro GET or SET result has yet been recorded.

subject: RIDCtrlEnable FC parameter transport
statement: Exact native analysis maps KeyValue RIDCtrlEnable to FC parameter rid_ctrl_enable_0 hash 0x3CBD864F and the FLYC 0x03/F7 metadata 0x03/F8 read 0x03/F9 write family with default modern app 2/4 to FC 18/4 routing.
boundary: The current DJI Fly 1.21.10 sample lacks the same strings and static SDK evidence does not establish Mini 5 Pro parameter admission type width HostID persistence or RF effect.

subject: Mini 5 Pro RIDCtrlEnable admission
statement: A fixed clean-room RC 2 Binder client can test only hash 0x3CBD864F with F7 followed by F8 and if both succeed can use F7-derived width plus the captured baseline for one F9 transition and restoration.
boundary: The APK has been copied to RC 2 removable storage but installation execution F7/F8 result F9 acceptance persistence and motor-on RF A-B-A are not yet observed.

subject: Current same-family RID configuration inventory
statement: A full RID key and native-handler inventory found rid_ctrl_enable_0 as the only RID-named FCConfig parameter; other writable surfaces are the regional 03/77 EID switch 03/78 operator identifier 11/4B Japan registration action and opaque set-only 00/DD cloud policy while status capability import-result and compliance identity surfaces are read-only.
boundary: No second closed global Boolean or free-form RID configuration family was found; catalog-only Eid names without a caller/native handler are weak candidates and opaque cloud data has no public schema or applied-state readback.

subject: Public Mini 5 Pro RID switch implementation search
statement: Fixed-revision GitHub projects and indexed exact-string searches found no independent Mini 5 Pro or RC 2 implementation of RIDCtrlEnable or rid_ctrl_enable_0; FreeFCC corroborates modern 0x82 transport 0x92 destination and 03/F9 framing but its parameter hash and feature are different.
boundary: The bounded search is not proof that private unindexed work does not exist and FreeFCC batch success does not prove individual Mini 5 Pro acceptance of the RID hash.
